mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.company_id AS companyId, c.name AS companyName, p.name, p.category, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, p.unit, p.description, p.region, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM parts p JOIN companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parts (company_id, name, category, unit_price, stock_quantity, unit, description, region) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{unitPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{unit}, #{description}, #{region})
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, name, category, unit_price, stock_quantity, unit, description, region, created_at, updated_at FROM parts WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY id ASC
